Watch Vijay Devarakonda, Rashmika Mandanna "Vachindamma" song from Geetha Govindam movie. Aditya Music presents the enchanting video song featuring Vijay Devarakonda and Rashmika Mandanna. With breathtaking vocals by Sid Sriram, this song is composed by Gopi Sundar and penned by Sri Mani.
